sloka: पुत्रार्थम् हयमेधेन यक्षयामि इति मतिर्मम ।तदहम् यष्टुम् इच्छामि हयमेधेन कर्मणा ॥१-१२-९॥
transliteration: putrārtham hayamedhena yakṣayāmi iti matirmama ।tadaham yaṣṭum icchāmi hayamedhena karmaṇā ॥1-12-9॥

translations.english: I wish to perform the yaga acording to scriptural procedures. And I will have my desire fulfilled by the grace of the sage (Rsyasringa)".
